text: Observed in the shared-expense-tracker pilot (e5dbe1f build): the protected-base Fail-Grant challenge offers exactly one choice, initialize-empty-protected-base, which authorizes pushing the current commit to the empty GitHub main. There is no grantable choice to continue governed planning locally without a protected base. R-000 says technical inability is not a permanent policy veto and that continue or accept-uncertain-result choices should be offered; a local-only pilot currently cannot plan without publishing.
